title: Generalization Guarantees on Data-Driven Tuning of Gradient Descent with Langevin Updates
abstract: arXiv:2604.13130v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study learning to learn through the lens of hyperparameter tuning. We propose the Langevin Gradient Descent Algorithm (LGD), which approximates the mean of the posterior distribution defined by the loss function and regularizer of a regression task with convex objective. For classification tasks, the LGD algorithm estimates the posterior probabilities of each class on the test set. We prove the existence of an optimal hyperparameter configuration for which the LGD algorithm achieves the Bayes' optimal solution for squared loss on regression tasks, and for which LGD closely approximates the posterior probabilities for well-specified classification tasks. Subsequently, we study generalization guarantees on meta learning optimal hyperparameters for the LGD algorithm from a given set of tasks in the data-driven setting. translated_title: 基于朗之万更新的梯度下降数据驱动调优的泛化保证
translated_abstract: 我们通过超参数调优的视角研究“学习如何学习”。我们提出了朗之万梯度下降算法（LGD），该算法近似由具有凸目标的回归任务的损失函数和正则化项所定义的后验分布的均值。对于分类任务，LGD算法估计测试集中每个类别的后验概率。我们证明了存在一个最优超参数配置，使得LGD算法在回归任务的平方损失下达到贝叶斯最优解，并且对于规范良好的分类任务，LGD能够紧密近似后验概率。随后，我们研究了在数据驱动设置下，从给定任务集合中元学习LGD算法最优超参数的泛化保证。对于参数数量为 $d$ 和超参数维度为 $h$ 的情况，我们证明了伪维数上界为 $O(dh)$。
tldr: 本文提出朗之万梯度下降算法（LGD）用于超参数调优，证明了存在最优超参数配置可使回归任务达到贝叶斯最优解，并为数据驱动元学习最优超参数提供了 $O(dh)$ 的伪维数泛化保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Langevin Gradient Descent (LGD) algorithm for hyperparameter tuning, proves the existence of an optimal hyperparameter configuration achieving Bayes-optimal solutions for regression tasks, and establishes pseudo-dimension generalization guarantees of O(dh) for data-driven meta-learning of optimal hyperparameters.
